name: Dronefront [BALLISTIC]
desc:
Welcome to Dronefront. Choose your side out of 3 teams!

🛡️ Live as an ordinary civilian, surviving drone attacks across towns, villages, and nearby facilities.

🔫 Be a Defender and stand up for your country, using weapons and anti-air defense machines to shoot down incoming drones, earn Fragments and buy better equipment.

🚀 Become a drone operator, launching FPV drones, missiles and strike drones to unleash chaos and destroy key infrastructure such as power plants, barracks, and ammunition storage sites, earning Fragments, to be able to buy better drones and equipment for strikes.

Join our community server to keep up with new updates on this game! 
This game is a work of fiction created solely for entertainment purposes.
It does not replicate, promote, or endorse any real-world wars, conflicts, or political events.

This game contains brief, bright flashes from explosions. Player discretion is advised, particularly for individuals with photosensitive epilepsy.
